get.summary: Get user progress summary, streaks, milestones, and goals
get.description:
Retrieve full progress summary for the authenticated user.

Pure read endpoint: creates no database records and never modifies state.
Returns 404 if user has no student profile.

put.summary: Create or update weekly goal for current or next week
put.description:
Set or update weekly target for roadmap items or minutes.

Only current week and next week Monday dates are editable.
Returns 404 if user has no student profile.

post.summary: Send message to AI academic advisor with grounded context
post.description:
Send message to AI advisor in one of the 4 context modes.

- Grounded strictly in retrieved catalog, roadmap, skill, or interview data.
- Evaluates safety pre-check before calling AI.
- Transaction closed during external AI call.
- Rate limited to 30 requests/hour.
